pages.ko: "우와, 숲이다!" 호리네 가족이 알록달록 가을 숲으로 나들이를 왔어요. 그런데 호리는 아직 시큰둥해요. "심심해— 뭐 하고 놀지?" 하며 발끝만 툭툭 찼어요. 숲은 이렇게나 예쁜데 말이에요.
pages.t: "Wow, a forest!" Hori's family came out for a trip to the colorful autumn forest. But Hori still seemed bored. "This is boring— what should I play?" he said, kicking at the ground with his toes. And the forest was so beautiful, too.

pages.ko: 아빠가 "저 나무 좀 봐, 정말 멋지지?" 했지만 호리는 "그냥 나무잖아…" 하고 시큰둥해요. 낙엽을 밟아도 "그냥 잎이고." 새가 노래해도 그냥 지나쳐요. 호리 눈엔 아무것도 특별해 보이지 않았어요.
pages.t: Dad said, "Look at that tree, isn't it amazing?" but Hori just said, "It's just a tree…" not very interested. Even stepping on fallen leaves, he said, "It's just leaves." Even when a bird sang, he just walked right past. Nothing looked special to Hori at all.

pages.ko: 그때 동생 호야가 낙엽을 한 움큼 집어 "와아—" 하늘로 뿌렸어요. 낙엽이 팔랑팔랑 춤추듯 떨어져요. 호야는 까르르 웃는데, 호리는 시무룩하게 바위에 앉아 있었어요. "나만 재미없어…"
pages.t: Just then, his little sibling Hoya scooped up a handful of leaves and tossed them up into the air with a shout, "Waah—!" The leaves fluttered and danced as they fell. Hoya giggled with delight, but Hori sat glumly on a rock. "I'm the only one not having fun…"

pages.ko: 엄마가 호리 옆에 앉아 살며시 눈을 감겨 줬어요. "호리야, 눈 감고 귀 쫑긋— 무슨 소리가 들려?" 호리가 가만히 귀를 기울이자, 바스락 낙엽 소리, 사르르 바람 소리, 짹짹 새소리가 들려왔어요. "어? 소리가 이렇게 많았어?"
pages.t: Mom sat down beside Hori and gently closed his eyes for him. "Hori, close your eyes and perk up your ears— what do you hear?" As Hori listened quietly, he heard the rustle of leaves, the whisper of the wind, and the chirping of birds. "Huh? There were this many sounds?"

pages.ko: 눈을 뜬 호리는 이제 온몸으로 숲을 느꼈어요. 낙엽을 밟으니 바스락바스락! 도토리를 손에 쥐니 매끈하고 동글동글! 바람이 볼을 살랑 간질이고, 코끝엔 흙과 나무 냄새가 폴폴. "우와, 숲이 이렇게 많은 걸 주고 있었구나!"
pages.t: When Hori opened his eyes, he began to feel the forest with his whole body. Stepping on leaves went rustle, rustle! Holding an acorn in his hand, it felt smooth and round! The wind tickled his cheeks gently, and the smell of earth and trees filled his nose. "Wow, the forest was giving me so much all along!"

pages.ko: 아빠가 도토리를 주우며 말했어요. "이 도토리는 다람쥐 겨울 양식이란다. 나무는 그늘을 주고, 바람은 시원함을 주지." 호리는 두 손 가득 도토리와 예쁜 단풍잎을 모았어요. "자연이 우리한테 이렇게 많이 나눠 주네!" 고마워, 자연아!
pages.t: Dad picked up an acorn and said, "This acorn is winter food for the squirrels. Trees give us shade, and the wind gives us a cool breeze." Hori gathered his hands full of acorns and pretty maple leaves. "Nature shares so much with us!" Thank you, nature!

pages.ko: 호리는 커다란 나무를 두 팔로 폭 안았어요. "나무야, 그늘 줘서 고마워!" 하늘을 보며 "햇살아, 따뜻하게 해 줘서 고마워!" 바람에게도 "바람아, 시원하게 해 줘서 고마워!" 고마워, 자연아!
pages.t: Hori wrapped his arms around a big tree in a hug. "Tree, thank you for the shade!" Looking up at the sky, he said, "Sunshine, thank you for keeping me warm!" And to the wind too, "Wind, thank you for the cool breeze!" Thank you, nature!

pages.ko: 호리 마음이 자연 사랑으로 가득 차올랐어요. 심심하던 숲이 세상에서 제일 멋진 놀이터가 되었어요! 그 순간 호리 꼬리 줄무늬가 무지개색으로 반짝— 부릉! 자연의 고마움을 알게 됐어요!
pages.t: Hori's heart filled up with love for nature. The forest that had seemed boring became the most wonderful playground in the world! At that moment, Hori's tail stripes sparkled in rainbow colors — vroom! He had come to understand how thankful he was for nature!

pages.ko: 돌아갈 시간, 호리는 자리에 떨어진 과자 봉지를 발견했어요. "자연을 아끼려면 깨끗하게 해 줘야지!" 호리는 쓰레기를 주워 봉투에 쏙 담았어요. "우리가 놀던 자리, 온 대로 깨끗하게!" 고마워, 자연아!
pages.t: When it was time to go home, Hori spotted a snack wrapper on the ground. "If I want to take care of nature, I should keep it clean!" Hori picked up the trash and tucked it neatly into a bag. "Let's leave the spot we played in as clean as we found it!" Thank you, nature!

pages.ko: 집으로 가는 길, 아빠 등에 업힌 호리가 노을 지는 숲을 돌아봤어요. "숲아, 오늘 정말 고마웠어. 또 놀러 올게!" 손에 쥔 단풍잎이 노을빛에 반짝였어요. 자연을 아끼고 고마워하는 마음, 참 예뻐요. 고마워, 자연아!
pages.t: On the way home, riding on Dad's back, Hori looked back at the forest glowing in the sunset. "Forest, thank you so much for today. I'll come visit again!" The maple leaf in his hand sparkled in the sunset light. Caring for nature and feeling grateful for it — what a beautiful heart to have. Thank you, nature!
